flips: UT-01 (Salt Lake City & West Valley City)

summaries.senate: The Democrats' chances of winning control of the Senate rose sharply in Polymarket odds, and the party remains the favourite. In [[South Carolina]], the Democrat Annie Andrews gained a lot of ground and the market shows a predicted flip, while the Democrat Josh Turek's odds in [[Iowa]] also climbed steeply, again with a predicted flip. The projected Senate count now stands at 54-46, down from 55-45, which still means Democrats gain control.
summaries.governor: The most striking move is in [[Texas]], where the Democrat Gina Hinojosa saw a sharp rise in Polymarket odds and the market now shows a predicted flip. In [[Kansas]], the Democrat Cindy Holscher also gained ground sharply, against the Republican Ty Masterson. Elsewhere, the Republican Byron Donalds in [[Florida]] strengthened sharply as well.
summaries.house: Polymarket odds show the Democrats' chances of winning the House rising by a sizable amount, with the party favoured to take control. In [[NC-14 (Gastonia & Huntersville)]], the Democrat Lakesha Womack gained sharply, and the market now lists the seat as a predicted flip. [[IN-05 (Fishers & Carmel)]] saw a similar sharp rise for the Democrat J. D.
